=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/_lib/import_audit.py.j2:29 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The `subprocess.run()` call has no timeout, so a hung import can stall validation indefinitely.
  WHY: A stalled import can block the audit until the process is killed.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/30_graceful_shutdown.sh.j2:15 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: `docker compose exec -T app` hardcodes the service name instead of using `APP_SERVICE`.
  WHY: If the compose service name changes, the graceful-shutdown test fails even though the repo is otherwise valid.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/tests/_lib/graceful_shutdown.py.j2:31-71 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The Python graceful-shutdown helper hardcodes `app` in its `subprocess.run()` calls instead of using the configured service name.
  WHY: The helper will break whenever the service is not named `app`, making the harness brittle.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-repo-checks/docker-compose.test.yml.j2:12 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The healthcheck still uses `test -x`, so it can fail when the entry script exists but is not executable.
  WHY: The file-existence fix did not remove the execute-bit gate, so a present-but-non-executable entry file still causes a false health failure; deepseek called it minor, while minimax and qwen treated it as a correctness failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
